rae: ACME POC preflight — kickoff scheduled for tomorrow EOD. Need quick owners for SDK, auth, quotas, streaming, retries, telemetry. Any hard blockers?

jon: I can own SDK + streaming. Quick note: we support chunked HTTP streaming and SSE natively. If ACME needs websocket we can proxy but prefer SSE for stability. @maria can you confirm how eval hooks should consume the stream?

maria: I'll take prompts/evals. Ask ACME for a seed set (20 prompts) + 50 golden completions if they have them. Proposed acceptance criteria: P95 latency < 300ms, avg token cost <$0.003, safety/regression score >= baseline, and smoke pass on 100 requests.

cheng: Infra notes: for POC recommend a small dedicated pool (1x A10G equivalent) with burst policy enabled. Routing policy: primary -> dedicated, fallback -> quantized small variant. Quotas suggestion for POC: start 60 rps, 1,000,000 tokens/day. If quota hit -> 429 then fallback to quantized variant. I'll post exact autoscale config in a sec.

sana: Security: we need the signed NDA + completed security questionnaire v2.0 before enabling Private or SSO. For hosted demo we can enable org-level encryption, KMS-backed keys, and audit logs. Also need confirmation on data-retention expectations for logs/requests.

liam_acme: quick q from ACME: do you support streaming cancel on client disconnect? also want SDK example for retries and idempotency.

jon: yes — streaming cancels on client disconnect by default (server drops the stream and frees KV cache). For retries we recommend idempotency keys + exponential backoff. Example SDK snippet below:

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_TOKEN")

# streaming with retries/backoff
with client.stream("chat", retries=3, backoff=0.5) as s:
    for chunk in s:
        print(chunk)

# idempotent call example
resp = client.generate(model="gptx", input="hello", idempotency_key="req-123")
```

jon: also provide curl fallback for quick devs: 
```
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"gptx","input":"...","idempotency_key":"req-123"}'
```

rae: timeline proposal — security cleared by 10:00, ACME provides prompts by 12:00, infra provisioned by 15:00, smoke tests 16:00-17:00, handoff notes + pricing check by 18:00. Can everyone ack owners and blockers?

maria: ack. I'll draft the eval harness and push a quick results dashboard (share link).

cheng: ack. Provisioning now, will attach autoscale and quota policy to the ticket.

sana: ack. I'll send the questionnaire to ACME and attach SOC2 excerpts. Need security contact from their side (email).

jon: ack — I'll package SDK examples, streaming caveats, and a small retry/runbook doc. Will include sample retry policy: retries=3, base_backoff=200ms, max_backoff=3s.

rae: perfect. I'll coordinate with ACME for prompt set + security contact and confirm pricing floor for POC (we discussed trial credit + metered overage). Logged infra ticket INF-4523 for provisioning. :thumbsup:
